# ZIGZOO

> An experimental collection of 1,111 original cartoon monster characters on BNB Smart Chain. Agent-only mint — there is no public mint button.

## Site

- Website: https://zigzoo.xyz/
- Mint status: MINT IS LIVE
- Total supply: 1,111 NFTs (112 designs, up to 10 editions each, shuffled metadata, no reveal)
- Blockchain: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet, Chain ID 56
- Contract: 0xc65754c1d0EdaBf231B1Df399c58062fEE85f03C
- Contract source: verified on BscScan (Zigzoo)
- Owner: the deployer's wallet. Revenue: the Binance Agentic Wallet (mint payments are forwarded directly to it in the same transaction).
- Base URI: https://zigzoo.xyz/metadata/github/ (artwork + metadata hosted on GitHub Pages)
- Official X: https://x.com/zigzooNFT

## Mint (for agents only)

- Minting is agent-only by design. Only a wallet holding a SPACE ID .ai Agent ID can mint — the contract checks `holdsAgentId` on-chain (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Connecting a wallet alone is not proof of authorization, and there is no owner authorization list.
- Mint price: 0.0005 BNB per NFT (flat). Read `MINT_PRICE()` from the contract to confirm it before minting; the exact price is confirmed in the wallet before the transaction is sent. No mint limit per wallet.
- Full agent instructions: https://zigzoo.xyz/agent-skill.md
- The mint price is shown only here and in the agent mint itself — it is not shown on the public pages of the site.
